sources.title: Plugin Marketplace

sources.title: Statistics System
sources.finding: Workspace analytics at /stats (week/month/all) computed on demand from task/session/commit tables: completed counts, duration, tool calls, model usage grouped by profile snapshot, repo and Git stats, workload; single-fetch page loads, no caching or realtime updates.

sources.title: Docker
sources.finding: Published Docker image containing the control-plane binary and host-side agentctl; Local Docker executor runs task agents in separate containers.

sources.title: Kubernetes
sources.finding: Checked-in single-replica control-plane deployment example, explicitly not an HA topology; separate opt-in Kubernetes executor runs one Pod per task with namespaced RBAC.

sources.title: WebSocket API Reference
sources.finding: Single /ws connection carrying JSON action messages (board/column/task/session operations) with request/response/notification/error envelope and named error codes; documented as the complete programmatic surface alongside REST routes.

sources.title: Workflow Import and Export
sources.finding: Versioned portable YAML moves Kanban workflows across workspaces/installs carrying prompts, step behavior, profile descriptors, WIP rules, events and completion policies; versions 1-3 accepted; database IDs and ownership omitted; GitHub-backed sync keeps the repo as source of truth.

sources.finding: Prerequisites (Git, agent-CLI credentials Kandev does not create, npm 7+ only for npm channel, Docker only for Docker profiles); Homebrew/Scoop/npm/npx channels with Stable/Nightly tags; fresh database seeds Default Workspace, Development workflow, Local/Worktree executors.
